description: PTC - STRUTTURA INSEDIATIVA (INVARIANTE III) Tratte stradali di valore paesistico percettivo (III.f) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by webgis2.ar-tel.it. The road sections of country interest constitute a complex of assets of a linear character of specific perceptual country value, represented by the road sections that by location and configuration allow you to enjoy the surrounding landscape, to exercise particular and special points of view on the valleys, plains and hilly and mountain slopes, or ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PTC – Establishment STRUCTURE (invariant III) Roads of perceptual country value (III.f)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
